Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

It seems your fixed-price alloy cover provides cost predictability that the headline market increases do not capture. We value the partnership and want to connect a longer commitment with a price grounded in your actual cost exposure. How do your material and processing costs reconcile with that cover and the increases already paid, and can you share the calculation in XLSX form so we can work through its elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled rose from EUR 5.17 to EUR 5.45 within 9 months (po:4500013278-10, po:4500013392-10, po:4500013795-10, po:4500014455-10). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.73 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.70 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.78 per unit, no index clause, 90 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We value your commitment to a 24-month volume and the proposed 14-day payment term, which enables us to adjust our offer.
While we do not share internal cost breakdowns, we acknowledge the recent development in PPI-C2431 and have factored this into our revised price.
As our fixed-price alloy cover only extends until March 2027, a 24-month agreement requires the inclusion of an AS-14404 index clause.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.29 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As a reliable supply partner, we always strive to find good solutions for our customers. We have verified the labour cost index data you provided and factored it into our calculation. Looking at our cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. Furthermore, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. As our fixed-price alloy cover only extends until March 2027, we must include an index clause for AS-14404 on a 24-month contract. 

In response to your movement, we can offer €5.14 per unit with 45 days payment terms, provided the AS-14404 index clause is included. Our offer consists of a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Besides this offer, we also present an alternative of a price of €5.14 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We are pleased to present our current proposal, which includes a price of €4.97 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As our fixed-price alloy cover ends in March 2027, a 24-month agreement must include the AS-14404 index clause. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer represents our most competitive position to conclude the agreement today. Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.09 per unit, combined with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a contract term of 24 months.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
